I contacted this practice looking for help with a routine wash for my dog while I was away from home for a week. I explained several times that I was out of town and was looking for some flexibility, however I was repeatedly told that the dog needed to be seen in person first and no alternative solution was offered.

Unfortunately, my experience with this practice has not been positive. On a number of occasions I found the staff on the phone to be abrupt and unhelpful. As a pet owner, you hope to feel that your animal's wellbeing is the priority, but my impression was that the focus was more on procedures and costs than assisting customers and their pets.

As a result, I moved to a smaller veterinary practice in a nearby village. The difference has been remarkable. They are far more attentive, approachable, and willing to work with pet owners to find practical solutions. Most importantly, I feel that they genuinely care about the animals they treat.

Based on my experience, I would not return to this practice and would recommend that others consider their options before registering.

We had an excellent experience with Sinead and the team, bringing our new puppy Walt in for his first check-up. From the moment we walked in, everyone was so welcoming, patient, and clearly very experienced. Sinead took the time to do a thorough exam and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand, which really helped calm our first-time puppy-parent nerves.
She went over vaccinations, nutrition, parasite prevention, and even gave helpful tips on training and general puppy care. Our puppy was handled so gently and never seemed stressed during the visit. We really appreciated that no question felt rushed or silly.
We couldn’t recommend Sinead and the team enough and we are so happy that we chose them for Walt’s care.

I can’t say enough good things about Sinead and all the staff at Cloyne Vet Clinic. They are incredibly caring, compassionate, and always go above and beyond for both pets and their owners. You can tell they genuinely love what they do and always take the time to explain everything, answer questions, and make sure your pet is comfortable. It’s such a relief knowing Shadow is in such capable and kind hands.

We were given conflicting information about the issues our pet had and the treatment involved. When we repeatedly followed up for clarification we were suddenly and out of the blue dropped as clients and our animals were refused treatment going forward. We were given no reason as to why this was the case.

With no explanation for this I can only assume that the vet involved made a mistake (which happens), but instead of owning up to this small and simple error and moving on, she got mad that we would highlight this to figure out what the actual situation with our pet was.

I’m sure being such a highly qualified and regarded person they would not like to be questioned in any way, but we were left in the dark about our pet’s health. Open and honest communication is so important when dealing with the lives of our family.

Despite having good interactions previously with Cloyne vets, it seems like the moment something goes wrong the wheels fall off and they kick you to the curb.

In good conscience I could not recommend this practice to anyone. Bring your animal friends to someone who cares for their health and who cares about your dignity as their family. Based on my experience it seems Cloyne vets does not value these things but more so cares about protecting their fragile egos.

I can’t thank the team enough for the kindness and care shown to my dog Bruno, especially in his final weeks.

The weekly injections for his arthritis made such a difference to his quality of life, and every visit he was treated so gently and with so much care. It was always clear that Bruno was genuinely looked after, not just rushed in and out.

When we had to say goodbye last week, the compassion shown to both Bruno and myself meant the world. I’ll always be grateful for everything you did for him and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this clinic.

Thank you 💙

We entrusted Cloyne Veterinary Clinic with the care of our cat, Mr Eddy, based on their reviews and their own claims made on their website about the service and standard of care they provide. Mr Eddy has complex medical needs, including significant dental issues, and requires ongoing treatment and medication. After respectfully requesting clarification about conflicting information regarding Mr Eddy’s ear findings and treatment plan, Dr. Suzanne Kelly withdrew his care without warning or discussion, leaving us without guidance for his medications, ongoing pain, or second planned surgery, which was cancelled without our consent and without regard for Mr Eddy's needs. No clear explanation or medical reasoning was provided.

We formally raised this with management and provided full evidence, but no meaningful resolution, transparency, or accountability followed. Instead, the situation was vaguely framed as the clinic being unable to meet our “expectations,” despite our expectations being basic: clear, consistent, and honest medical information about our pet's condition.

The impact of this has been severe, both for Mr Eddy’s welfare and for us as his carers. Abruptly withdrawing care after reasonable requests for clarification is unacceptable and unsafe. Veterinary care should be based on professionalism, continuity, transparency, and animal welfare. This experience demonstrates a serious failure in all of those areas.

I am sharing this so others can make informed decisions and because no animal or carer should be left without care, guidance, or basic answers after respectfully seeking clarity from someone responsible for his medical care.
